title: Active browser acceptance drivers read retired OAuth token storage
reproduction: On current main, inspect src/config/env.ts STORAGE_KEYS.AUTH_SESSION: it is matrx.oauth.session, introduced by 9fbf35f035.
Inspect the active member-data route in scripts/hosted-guest-acceptance.mjs and its tests/browser/data-member-native-acceptance.mjs driver.
In the driver's saved-pattern lookup and cleanup functions, observe that both read only matrx.auth.accessToken and return status 0 without making their request when that retired key is absent.
expected: A signed-in native acceptance driver obtains the current OAuth session in the browser realm, sends authenticated fixture/readback requests, and records only sanitized outcomes.
actual: Current source uses the OAuth session blob, but the active Data member driver still reads the retired token key for lookup and cleanup. The source mismatch is reproducible; the failure on a fresh current-artifact browser session has not yet been observed. A historical Data member pass on v0.2.493 predates the October 12 OAuth storage change and does not verify the current driver.
severity: S2: authenticated acceptance can stop in fixture setup or cleanup before product behavior, obscuring current member/admin coverage
priority: P1: repair active native auth consumers before interpreting new signed-in test failures
sibling_census: A source search finds 50 browser .mjs/.cjs files referencing matrx.auth.accessToken, including historical scripts. This count is a review queue, not 50 proven active failures. EXT-D-0217's hosted Save route is being repaired separately; enumerate active routes before extending this fix.
next_action: Review the current hosted route graph, migrate active browser fixture consumers to one shared current-OAuth session reader without exposing bearer values in reports, show old-code RED/current-code GREEN, and perform one guarded current-artifact member run with independent review. Preserve historical v0.2.493 Data evidence as historical.

transition_history.reason: Current OAuth storage and active Data member driver source disagree after the October 12 auth change.
The exact source mismatch and affected request helpers are identified; fresh browser impact and remaining active siblings still require verification.
